abstract: OBJECTIVE: To describe the incidence, clinical characteristics, treatment methods and long-term follow-up of bilateral germ cell tumours of the testis (GCTT) in patients treated at one institution. PATIENTS AND METHODS: Of 552 patients with GCTT, 11 (2%, mean age 26. 9 years) developed bilateral disease; all 11 underwent radical orchidectomy. Additional treatment was planned according to the histological type and clinical stage of the tumour, and previous treatments. Intramuscular testosterone was administered periodically after total castration. The data on survival, sexual status and treatment complications were reviewed. RESULTS: Of the 11 patients, seven developed a second tumour metachronously (median interval 87 months) and four had synchronous bilateral GCTT. Cryptorchidism, infertility or atrophic testis was associated with the development of bilateral GCTT in seven of the 11 patients. All synchronous tumours and most of the sequential tumours had identical histology on both sides. Although all sequential tumours presented at an early clinical stage, three of four synchronous bilateral GCTTs presented at an advanced stage. Five patients received platinum-based chemotherapy; three patients underwent post- chemotherapy resection of the retroperitoneal residual mass. Sexual libido and potency were conserved in all patients. No significant morbidity was recorded as being caused by any of these treatments. At a median follow-up of 11. 6 years, all patients were alive with no evidence of cancer. CONCLUSIONS: All patients with unilateral GCTT have an increased risk of developing a contralateral testicular tumour, even decades after diagnosis. Management should be adapted to each patient. As all patients in this series survived in the long-term, developing a second germ cell cancer does not necessarily predict a poor prognosis.

目的：単一施設で治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍(GCTT)患者のうち両側発生例の頻度、臨床的特徴、治療法、長期フォローアップを記述する。
患者と方法：GCTT患者552例のうち11例(2%、平均年齢26.9歳)が両側発生し、全例に根治的精巣摘除術を施行した。追加治療は組織型・臨床病期・既往治療に基づいて計画した。完全去勢後は定期的に筋肉内テストステロンを投与した。生存、性機能、治療合併症に関するデータを検討した。
結果：11例中7例は異時性に第2腫瘍を発症し(中央値間隔87か月)、4例は同時性に両側GCTTを認めた。停留精巣、不妊、萎縮精巣は11例中7例で両側GCTTの発生に関連していた。同時性腫瘍は全例、異時性腫瘍の多くは両側で同一組織型であった。異時性腫瘍は全て早期病期で発見されたが、同時性両側GCTT 4例中3例は進行期で発見された。白金製剤併用化学療法を5例に施行し、3例は化学療法後に後腹膜残存腫瘤切除を受けた。性欲と性機能は全例で保たれた。重大な治療合併症は認められなかった。中央値11.6年の追跡時点で、全例が生存し無病であった。
結論：片側GCTTの患者は、診断から数十年後であっても反対側に精巣腫瘍を発症するリスクが高い。治療は各患者に応じて調整すべきである。本シリーズで全例が長期生存したことから、第2の胚細胞腫瘍を発症しても必ずしも予後不良を意味しない。
